videos.title: What To Do With Your Life
videos.summary: Asking yourself what to do with your life is an overwhelming question that usually leads to analysis paralysis. By breaking your life into concrete areas, unconstrained dream mapping, and structured Odyssey planning prompts, this practical 3-step framework turns vague existential dread into a clear personal compass. Watch this video to uncover what you truly want to optimize for—and just as importantly, what you want to avoid.

timestamps.topic: Why 'What to do with my life?' is the wrong question to ask
Defining career lifestyle characteristics instead of fixating on job titles
The Odyssey Plan: Mapping 3 alternate 5-year futures

videos.title: How builders at YC Startup School are using Gemini & Google AI
videos.summary: Discover how the next generation of top founders and researchers are deploying cutting-edge AI tools—from Gemini Flash to AlphaFold—to solve critical engineering and healthcare challenges. See firsthand how builders are parsing complex global financial data, pioneering drug discovery against antibiotic resistance, and accelerating academic breakthroughs. Watch to uncover practical, real-world inspiration for integrating advanced AI models into your own workflow today.

timestamps.topic: Parsing complex global documents and receipts with Gemini Flash

videos.title: Insurans atau Takaful?
videos.summary: Relying solely on takaful or insurance without an emergency fund is a dangerous financial mistake that could leave you stranded if you suddenly lose your job. Discover why medical coverage won't pay your living commitments and why you need a three-pillar safety net—emergency funds, sinking funds, and takaful—to achieve true financial security.

timestamps.topic: Why Takaful Alone Cannot Replace an Emergency Fund During Layoffs
The Essential 3-Part Financial Safety Net You Must Have

If you want a real masterclass on scaling an F&B business without losing brand equity, this insider discussion is an essential watch.
